acceptance: An advisory job runs on site PRs, compares against the deployed artifact, and uploads diffs without failing ci
The job is not in the ci aggregate's needs
context: Split out of site-split-21 (step 4, advisory visual regression) on 2026-10-09: the comparison needs a deployed artifact and receipts, which the deploy plane (site-split-23) provides. S1 (benchbox-site PR #1) shipped the rest of item 21.
description:
Owner decision D8: visual regression in the site repo is advisory, not part of the required `ci` aggregate.

1. Add a site CI job that captures the public pages from the PR build (the Explorer's `test:e2e:public-site` capture spec is the starting point) and compares them with captures of the currently deployed artifact, found through the newest deploy receipt.
2. Report differences as a job summary and an uploaded diff artifact; never fail `ci` on them.
3. Port or drop `explorer/scripts/download-public-site-visual-baseline.mjs`, which expects core's baseline artifacts.
